title: Textile Engineering Intern
body: Completed an internship at Fariha Knit Tex Ltd., a manufacturing unit of Asrotex Group, with exposure to end-to-end knit apparel production.
responsibilities:
• Assisted with production monitoring and quality control workflows.
  • Gained practical exposure to knitted fabric manufacturing and machinery operations.
  • Developed an understanding of factory-floor logistics within a large-scale textile environment.
